profiles.name: Software Studio
profiles.tagline: A repeatable Python, TypeScript, container and database workstation.
profiles.network: Needed only to install packages, fetch dependencies and use cloud agents.
profiles.accounts: No account for the base tools. Optional coding agents use their own sign-in.

profiles.name: AI Lab
profiles.tagline: Local model collaboration, notebooks, model provenance and GPU checks.
profiles.network: Needed to install tools and download a model. Ice keeps agent sessions offline by default.
profiles.accounts: Base tools need no account. Gated Hugging Face models may require the user's own token.
profiles.accelerator: CPU works; Vulkan, NVIDIA CUDA or AMD ROCm can accelerate supported workloads.

profiles.name: Production Ops
profiles.tagline: Rootless image builds, automation, runbooks and observable delivery.
profiles.network: Needed for registries and remote systems. Credentials remain in each tool's native store.
profiles.accounts: No account for local work; registries and providers use their own authentication.

profiles.name: Creative AI
profiles.tagline: A provenance-ready image, video, audio and generative workflow.
profiles.network: Needed to install applications and any optional models. Creation works offline afterward where tools allow.
profiles.accounts: No account for the base creative applications.
profiles.accelerator: A supported GPU is recommended for 3D and generative workloads.
